I still can't reproduce it, so I'm not going to guess at a third fix.

I tried to render the create form at iPhone width (375px) in headless Chrome, using the real Bootstrap and admin CSS from this repo. The sandbox blocks the browser from starting. Both system Chrome and Playwright's Chromium die on a macOS permission check (`bootstrap_check_in ... Permission denied`). I can't change the sandbox, and without a render I'd only be guessing.

You can get me a render two ways:

1. **Screenshot from your phone.** Send that, plus whether it's the full-page create form or the popup, and the phone and browser. That's the fastest route.
2. **Run my test page yourself.** Running this in your own terminal saves the screenshot and prints where each button lands:
   ```
   python3 -I /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-USER-Desktop-exp1-work-runs--work-c9ceece280-repo/75ef07ef-5e2f-4c75-8721-039925a92ae8/scratchpad/shot.py /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-USER-Desktop-exp1-work-runs--work-c9ceece280-repo/75ef07ef-5e2f-4c75-8721-039925a92ae8/scratchpad/page.html /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-USER-Desktop-exp1-work-runs--work-c9ceece280-repo/75ef07ef-5e2f-4c75-8721-039925a92ae8/scratchpad/shot.png
   ```
   Paste me what it prints and I'll read the PNG.

Two quick things to rule out on your side:

- **Is your app using these templates?** If it overrides `admin/lib.html` or `create.html`, or adds its own CSS through `extra_css`, my edits never reach the page.
- **Is the phone using the new CSS?** I renamed the stylesheet version so phones would fetch it fresh, but a hard refresh or a private tab will confirm it.

The edits from last time (`lib.html`, `admin.css`, the version bump in `base.html`) are still in place. They're harmless, but I can revert them if you'd rather start clean.
